body.x: AU Tech (CEO Geunho Cho) participated in the 2024 Future Innovation Tech Expo (FIX 2024), held from October 23 to 26 at Daegu EXCO. Specializing in electric mobility solutions, AU Tech offers high-quality, sustainable transportation options to both industries and consumers. It focuses on electric two-wheelers, carts, and wheelchairs to enhance daily convenience and environmental preservation.

At FIX 2024, AU Tech presented its diverse e-mobility brand ECORO lineup. The X Series led the showcase, a range of electric scooters designed for safe and comfortable urban commuting. Despite their compact appearance, these scooters feature high-performance batteries, exceptional durability, efficient climbing ability, and superior drivability. Their eco-conscious design and cost-effective maintenance further underline their appeal.

Another highlight was the E-Porter line of commercial electric three-wheelers, tailored to meet logistics and delivery demands. With ample cargo capacity and long-range capabilities, the E-Porter offers silent operation and eco-friendliness, making it ideal for small—to medium-scale logistics industries.

body.cap: AU Tech’s commercial electric three-wheeler E-Porter | Photo by AVING News

body.x: AU Tech also introduced its Golden Chair series of electric wheelchairs and scooters, which cater to seniors and mobility-impaired users. With customizable designs and functional features, the series attracted significant interest from visitors and received positive feedback for its user-centric approach.

An AU Tech representative stated, “Through this exhibition, we aim to showcase AU Tech’s vision for the future of mobility and introduce our innovative products to customers and partners. By promoting our eco-friendly and user-friendly e-mobility products, we seek to establish collaborations with global partners while enhancing brand awareness in domestic and international markets.”

They added, “Our core value lies in delivering efficient, safe, innovative mobility solutions that improve user experience. We will continue strengthening our global competitiveness and aim to lead the sustainable urban mobility sector.”

body.cap: AU Tech booth at FIX 2024 | Photo by AVING News

body.x: FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
